description_citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas engineers a world where inhabitants reach physical perfection before killing each other in the Trials, to create an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bolas's goal was the creation of an army of Zombie warriors known as Eternals

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Under Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The worthy dead are carried through the gate on funerary barges, embalmed, coated in lazotep and fitted with weapons to become Eternals.
timeline.quote: The truly worthy dead, however, received far greater honor.

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Angels announce the Eternals come and the gates of the central mausoleum open.
timeline.quote: The Eternals come!

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The scarab god leads thousands of blue-glazed Eternals, including past champions, out of the mausoleum.
timeline.quote: in the wake of his implacable dark divinity, came an army.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nylah is swarmed by the Eternals and gladly killed, crying that she now believes.
timeline.quote: Each blade sunk into her flesh with a cold kiss

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Asenue holds off two Eternals to give others time to escape, though she knows she will lose.
timeline.quote: Every moment she stayed alive, that was another person not dying

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Asenue falters in mid-breath, implying her death.
timeline.quote: One more breath. One more breath. One. More. Brea —

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Genub and Makare flee together from the Eternals, but Genub loses her in the chaos.
timeline.quote: When next he stopped to breathe, Makare was not there.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Genub finds Makare, now an Eternal with glowing blue eyes, who cuts him down as he reaches for her.
timeline.quote: Hers was not the only blade that punctured his flesh, but it was the first.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit, enraged at Oketra's death, takes one of her arrows as a spear and destroys a minotaur Eternal.
timeline.quote: There was a flash of white light as the minotaur disintegrated

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit's shield fails and the Eternals close in on her.
timeline.quote: The Eternals closed in, and Kawit did not have strength enough left to scream.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Amenakhte, mortally wounded after shielding a child with his body, begs a human woman to save the child and dies.
timeline.quote: all that Amenakhte had time to do was put himself between the falling blades and the child

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace wonders what Bolas's plan is for the Eternals.
timeline.quote: If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?

citation.text: Eternal of Harsh Truths (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh was revealed to have built a factory to produce an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh's benevolence concealed the factory he created to produce an army of Eternals.

citation.text: Frontline Devastator (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Final Hours the sealed gates swing open as the Second Sun aligns with the horns of the monument, revealing an army of Eternals.
timeline.quote: the sealed gates finally swung open as foretold when the Second Sun aligned with the horns of the God-Pharaoh's monument

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scarab God leads the lazotep-coated dead out to transform Naktamun's people into an undead legion in the Hour of Eternity.
timeline.quote: the Scarab God led countless generations of lazotep-coated dead out from the crypt

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Chandra visits the crypt, destroys a stay band of Eternals and obliterates the statue of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: then obliterated the massive statue of Nicol Bolas inside the crypt

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas's deception is revealed as three gods of destruction shatter the Hekma and slay most of the other gods while mummies and Eternals attack.
timeline.quote: Three unknown gods of destruction emerged, shattered the Hekma , and slew most of the other gods.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "Alignment of the Second Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The scarab-headed god leads Bolas's Eternals out of the necropolis.
timeline.quote: These were Bolas 's Eternals : the worthy dead of Naktamun, remade into flawless soldiers

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru reunite and rally surviving initiates against the Scorpion God and the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Rallying as many surviving initiates as they could, they fought back against the Scorpion God and the Eternal horde.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas comes to claim his perfect zombie army, the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas has come to claim his perfect zombie army, the Eternals .

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian invasion of Amonkhet the necropolis serves as recruiting ground for the invaders.
timeline.quote: the Necropolis served as prime recruiting grounds for the invaders

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Eternals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru fight the Eternal Neheb the Worthy and are beaten back.
timeline.quote: Neheb swung his spear forward, sending a wave of flame at Samut.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: They deduce Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals and the Sun would trap anyone who arrives.
timeline.quote: He made an army he could transport across the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Domri first fights the Eternals and helps save Kaya, then sides with Bolas after seeing him topple the Vitu-Ghazi elemental.
timeline.quote: even helped save Kaya in a tight spot

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas casts the Elderspell after the Dreadhorde invades Ravnica, empowering the Eternals to harvest sparks.
timeline.quote: Bolas cast the Elderspell to grow his power by absorbing the sparks

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel Cane fights off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind.
timeline.quote: Davriel Cane was able to fight off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of planeswalkers are killed and their sparks harvested, making Bolas nearly invulnerable.
timeline.quote: Hundreds of planeswalkers were killed by Eternals

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers fight alongside the Gatewatch against Bolas and his Eternals, unaware that Bolas is relying on their interference.
timeline.quote: Little do the Gatewatch suspect that Bolas has not only accounted for their interference, but he is practically relying on it.

citation.text: "War of the Spark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret opens the Planar Bridge to Amonkhet, letting Liliana lead the Dreadhorde through, and destroys the Embassy of the Guildpact, making Jace lose the Living Guildpact power.
timeline.quote: causing Jace to lose the power of the Living Guildpact

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas' Eternals invade Ravnica, slaughtering civilians to lure out planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Bolas' Eternals invade Ravnica, indiscriminately slaughtering civilians to lure out Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Boros Legion, with Gideon's help, counterattacks and initially drives back the invaders.
timeline.quote: With the help of Gideon , their assault is initially successful in driving back the invaders.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa animates Vitu-Ghazi and topples Bolas' statue, boosting Ravnican morale.
timeline.quote: She uses the massive elemental to topple Bolas' statue

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas casts the Elderspell and Domri becomes the first planeswalker drained of his spark and killed.
timeline.quote: Domri, despite pledging his loyalty to Bolas, is the first Planeswalker to be drained of his spark and killed.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the final assault on Bolas' Citadel, Dack is killed by Eternals who harvest his spark.
timeline.quote: During the battle, Dack is killed by Eternals, who harvest his spark.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On their arrival on Ravnica the Eternals become known as Bolas's Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: the Eternals from Amonkhet became known as Bolas 's Dreadhorde .

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Dreadhorde". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A raven-haired woman puts on a golden veil, her skin glows with purple tattoos, and she commands the marching Eternal army to slaughter the crowd.
timeline.quote: the army stopped as one and turned to look her way

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
timeline.quote: Mistress Kaya said, "Run."

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
timeline.quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
timeline.quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
timeline.quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gruul warriors led by Domri Rade charge the Eternals from behind and save the trio.
timeline.quote: attacked the Eternals from behind, axes chopping through lazotep.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: A viashino planeswalker is killed by an Eternal that drains his life force, and the fire shoots toward Bolas.
timeline.quote: Then that fire rocketed into the air, shooting like a comet toward Tenth District Plaza and the dragon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Bolas' army of Eternals is revealed and unleashed.
timeline.quote: Bolas' army of Eternals is revealed and unleashed

citation.text: "Accounting of Hours", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bilagru and another Orzhov giant protect Kaya in battle against the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bilagru and another Orzhov giant protected Kaya during a chaotic battle against the Eternals.

citation.text: "Bilagru", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta and the Gruul arrive in time to save Kaya, Teyo and Araithia from the Eternals; Gan is nearly killed and saved by the trio.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta was almost killed by an Eternal but was saved by the combined efforts of Teyo, Kaya, and Araithia.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eternals emerge to bring death and ruin.
timeline.quote: the silent ranks of the Eternals emerged to bring death and ruin instead of eternal rest

citation.text: "Gate to the Afterlife", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Govan joined other Gruul warriors in attacking the Eternals during the War of the Spark.
timeline.quote: Govan joined forces with other Gruul warriors to attack the Eternals

citation.text: "Govan Radley", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazotep is secretly hidden aboard funerary barges and delivered to the necropolis to coat the bodies of the chosen dead, forging the Eternals.
timeline.quote: forging an army in waiting for the prophesied return of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Lazotep Mines", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylah witnessed the Scarab God arrive with the Eternals and desired their fate.
timeline.quote: Nylah witnessed the arrival of a dread figure

citation.text: "Nylah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nylah embraced the Eternals and was stabbed to death, believing her faith rewarded.
timeline.quote: She shouted her belief as they swarmed and stabbed her

citation.text: "Nylah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Final Hours Bolas manifested above his throne as the city fell and the gods lay slain.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas finally appeared, manifesting above his throne

citation.text: "Throne of the God-Pharaoh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: She fights Eternals she once knew.
relations.quote: knew them I guess from when they were her friends.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.
